seo.title: Krabi Airport to Ao Nang Private Minivan | VIP Taxi Lanta
seo.metaDescription: Private minivan between Krabi Airport (KBV) and Ao Nang, both directions, straight to your hotel. Cash to the driver, no prepayment. Price on WhatsApp.

routes.h1: Krabi Airport to Ao Nang by private minivan
routes.lead: From the arrivals at Krabi Airport (KBV) to your hotel in Ao Nang, or the other way, in a private minivan.
body: Send your flight number and landing time, your hotel in Ao Nang and the number of people. The team confirms the price on WhatsApp and the driver waits in the arrivals hall with a sign showing your name.

faq.q: Can you drop us at a pier in Ao Nang for Railay?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us which pier and at what time in the request form.

points: Hotels on all the beaches of Khao Lak

seo.title: Phuket Airport to Khao Lak Private Minivan | VIP Taxi Lanta
seo.metaDescription: Private minivan between Phuket Airport (HKT) and Khao Lak, both directions, straight to your hotel. Cash to the driver. Price on WhatsApp.

routes.h1: Phuket Airport to Khao Lak by private minivan
routes.lead: From Phuket Airport (HKT) to your hotel in Khao Lak, or back to the airport for your flight, in a private minivan.
body: Give us your flight time, your hotel in Khao Lak and the number of people. The team confirms the price on WhatsApp and the driver waits in the arrivals hall with a sign showing your name.

seo.title: Krabi to Khao Sok Private Minivan | VIP Taxi Lanta
seo.metaDescription: Private minivan between Krabi, Ao Nang or Krabi Airport and Khao Sok or Cheow Lan Pier, both directions. Cash to the driver. Price on WhatsApp.

routes.h1: Krabi to Khao Sok by private minivan
routes.lead: From Krabi Town, Ao Nang or Krabi Airport to Khao Sok village or Cheow Lan Pier, and back, in a private minivan.
body: Tell us where we pick you up in Krabi and whether you are going to the village or to Cheow Lan Pier, with your boat time if you have one. The team confirms the price on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Do you drive to Cheow Lan Pier?
faq.a: Yes. Write Cheow Lan Pier as the drop-off, with the time of your boat.

seo.title: Phuket to Khao Sok Private Minivan | VIP Taxi Lanta
seo.metaDescription: Private minivan between Phuket or Phuket Airport and Khao Sok or Cheow Lan Pier, both directions, door to door. Cash to the driver. Price on WhatsApp.

routes.h1: Phuket to Khao Sok by private minivan
routes.lead: From your hotel in Phuket or from Phuket Airport to Khao Sok village or Cheow Lan Pier, and back, in a private minivan.
body: Tell us where we pick you up in Phuket and whether you are going to the village or to Cheow Lan Pier. The team confirms the price on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can you pick us up at Phuket Airport for Khao Sok?
faq.a: Yes. Send your flight time and the driver waits in the arrivals hall with a sign showing your name.

seo.title: Surat Thani to Khao Sok Private Minivan | VIP Taxi Lanta
seo.metaDescription: Private minivan between Surat Thani (airport, bus terminal or Donsak Pier) and Khao Sok or Cheow Lan Pier, both directions. Price on WhatsApp.

routes.h1: Surat Thani to Khao Sok by private minivan
routes.lead: From Surat Thani Airport, the bus terminal or Donsak Pier to Khao Sok village or Cheow Lan Pier, and back, in a private vehicle.
body: Tell us where we pick you up in Surat Thani and at what time. The team confirms the price on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Do you pick up at Donsak Pier for Khao Sok?
faq.a: Yes. Give us your ferry arrival time and the driver waits at the pier.

seo.title: Phuket Airport to Ao Nang Private Minivan | VIP Taxi Lanta
seo.metaDescription: Private minivan between Phuket Airport (HKT) and Ao Nang or Krabi, both directions, straight to your hotel. Cash to the driver. Price on WhatsApp.

routes.h1: Phuket Airport to Ao Nang by private minivan
routes.lead: From Phuket Airport (HKT) to your hotel in Ao Nang or Krabi Town, or back to the airport, in a private minivan.
body: Give us your flight time, your hotel and the number of people. The team confirms the price on WhatsApp and the driver waits in the arrivals hall with a sign showing your name.

faq.q: Do you also drive to Krabi Town from Phuket Airport?
faq.a: Yes. Write Krabi Town or your hotel as the drop-off.
